# go-modern-maps-keys-values-iter

**Since:** Go 1.23

## Summary

Use maps.Keys or maps.Values directly as iterators instead of manually looping over a map.

## Details

maps.Keys and maps.Values can be ranged over directly when a slice is not needed.
This avoids allocating a temporary collection just to iterate.

## Examples

### Before

```go
for k := range m {
  process(k)
}
```

### After

```go
for k := range maps.Keys(m) {
  process(k)
}
```

Source: [https://github.com/JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines/blob/main/internal/guidelines/guidelines.json](https://github.com/JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines/blob/main/internal/guidelines/guidelines.json)
